verdict.rationale: Official docs (gemini-docs-8 and gemini-docs-25) say Gemini models can be reached through the OpenAI Python and TypeScript/JavaScript libraries and the REST API by changing three lines of code and using a Gemini API key. That covers the core of pointing existing OpenAI-compatible tooling at the platform. A community note also shows Gemini is reachable through OpenRouter, a third-party intermediary. Missing for 10: details on how fully the OpenAI-compatible endpoint matches OpenAI features and its limits, documented migration paths from other providers' SDKs (e.g. Anthropic), and independent hands-on corroboration that the compatibility layer works as claimed.
